title: The Unmarked Seat
text: A new Seat stands on the hill where there was only grass yesterday, walls of grey stone, towers, a gate. Its banners bear no device. Its windows are lit every night. Nobody goes in or out, but the shapes in the windows move.

options.label: Send an envoy to the Seat on the hill, to learn who has come to the city.

outcomes.text: The envoy comes back with a gift and a message: "We are patient."
The envoy comes back with a gift, and without a shadow.
The envoy comes back days later, unable to speak of it and unable to sleep.

options.label: Set it alight, before whatever lives there decides to visit.

outcomes.text: It burns all night with a light like noon. In the morning the hill is grass again.
It burns. In the morning it stands untouched, and one of the Houses' own halls is ash.

options.label: Do nothing, and tell the children not to look.

outcomes.text: The windows stay lit. Some nights there are more of them.
